address: Al Falah Street, Old Passport Rd, Zone 1, Abu Dhabi
bio: Owner Chandy and his team runs this sweet little Malaysian restaurant with passion, politeness and professionalism - and clearly want everyone to enjoy themselves. That proves easy, thanks to the inexpensive, fresh and flavoursome dishes on the short menu that’s supplemented with a blackboard of specials; roti jala is always well worth ordering. The place is immaculately kept, with views into the equally spotless kitchen.
